definition.description: Neutral-atom compute with a remote superconducting magic-state accelerator.
definition.name: NA-C + SC-F

provenance.factory_rule: pinned QEC resource protocol; legacy model field is consistency-checked for report-v1 codec parity

assumptions.cycle_derivation: source-reported 19 syndrome-extraction cycles per attempt times 1.06 expected attempts
assumptions.default_status: ArqSim reference default; constant-rate profiles remain non-default sensitivity options because their end-to-end cycle counts are not source-reported
assumptions.idle_error_during_protocol: omitted, matching the paper's main evaluation
assumptions.output_error: conservative use of the paper's stated below-1e-10 result
assumptions.qec_cycle: cross-modality protocol uses the slower neutral-atom endpoint, 1 ms per QEC cycle

source.paper: Sunami et al., Entanglement boosting: Low-volume logical Bell pair preparation for distributed fault-tolerant quantum computation

assumptions.delivered_storage_patch: resize escaped d=15 state to the computation's d=13 surface-code patch
assumptions.retry_model: rounded mean interval; exponential sampling is a temporary evaluation model
assumptions.target_regime: artifact operating point: 1.9689e-9 T-error proxy at complementary-gap cutoff 108

source.artifact_record: end2end-inplace-distillation, d1=5, d2=15, p=0.001, complementary-gap cutoff=108
source.paper: Gidney, Shutty, and Jones, Magic state cultivation: growing T states as cheap as CNOT gates
